title: fix(ui): keep task progress steps aligned as status changes
body:
## What Problem This Solves Task markers in the chat Details panel sit in the middle of wrapped descriptions. Align them with the first text line and connect the steps with a subtle vertical rail. ## User Impact Task status changes keep the rows aligned. The approved typography, spacing, spinner and pending-circle appearance are preserved. Commentary links use medium weight. ## Why This Change Was Made The Details checklist shares a fixed marker column and first-line alignment. A quiet vertical rail connects the steps without changing progress state or interactions. ## Risk and coverage - Production changes only the Details stylesheet (+25/-7); no renderer, state or icon-registry changes. - All six existing browser cases passed after the test audit (32.42s), covering desktop/mobile and touch, first-line alignment, Home gesture handles, scroll independence and unread fades. - Targeted lint, formatting and diff checks passed. - Removed the newly added visual-constant tests and measurement helper. The existing browser test changes only its desktop first-line expectation (+1/-2); no new tests. - Production CSS is unchanged from the previously reviewed and captured version, so the images and video below still represent it. ## Screenshots Both columns use the same 266 × 276 px crop at native scale. | Theme | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | Light | | | | Dark | | | ## Four-step lifecycle The original spinner runs for approximately three seconds on each step before all four checks appear.
